payout_quote: Find rebates and special offers near you on ENERGY STAR certified products.
timing: Varies by offer: instant rebates at participating retailers, or mail-in/online rebates typically paid 4-8 weeks after purchase.
eligibility: Set by each rebate offer in the finder: generally must purchase an ENERGY STAR certified product (specific model numbers) from a participating retailer or through your utility's program during the offer window.
catches: Every rebate requires buying the appliance first — this is a discount on spending, not money earned.
Typical rebates are $25-$150 per product; the $500 top end is rare and offer-specific.
Offers are local and expire — always confirm the offer is live before buying.
The product must be on the certified list; a non-certified model, even efficient, does not qualify.
steps: Go to https://www.energystar.gov/rebate-finder and enter your zip code to see live rebates near you.
Open a specific offer and confirm it is current, the exact qualifying model numbers, and the purchase window.
Buy the qualifying ENERGY STAR certified product from a participating retailer.
Submit the rebate form with proof of purchase; the rebate arrives as a check, gift card, or bill credit, typically in 4-8 weeks.
biggest_catch: A live EPA directory of real rebates — but every one requires buying the appliance first; it is a discount on spending, not money earned, and typical amounts are $25-$150 per product, not $500.
